readings.title: The Light of the Menorah
readings.subtitle: Aaron Sets Up the Lamps
readings.text: [Numbers 8:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [2] <dq>“Speak to Aharon, and say to him, ‘When you arrange the lamps, let the seven lamps give light in front of the lampstand.’”</dq> [3] And Aharon did so. He arranged the lamps to face the front of the lampstand, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded Mosheh. [4] And this is the work of the lampstand: beaten gold, from its base to its blossoms it is beaten work. According to the pattern which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had shown Mosheh, so he made the lampstand.

readings.title: The Cleansing of the Levites
readings.subtitle: Setting Apart the Ministers
readings.text: [Numbers 8:5] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [6] <dq>“Take the Lĕwites from among the children of Yisra’ĕl and you shall cleanse them.</dq> [7] <dq>“And do this to them to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of sin offering on them, and they shall shave all their body, and shall wash their garments, and cleanse themselves,</dq> [8] <dq>“and shall take a young bull with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, while you take another young bull as a sin offering.</dq> [9] <dq>“And you shall bring the Lĕwites before the Tent of Appointment, and you shall assemble all the congregation of the children of Yisra’ĕl.</dq> [10] <dq>“And you shall bring the Lĕwites before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and the children of Yisra’ĕl shall lay their hands on the Lĕwites,</dq> [11] <dq>“and Aharon shall wave the Lĕwites before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> as a wave offering from the children of Yisra’ĕl, and they shall be for doing the service of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [12] <dq>“And the Lĕwites shall lay their hands on the heads of the young bulls. And one shall be prepared as a sin offering and the other as an ascending offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, to make atonement for the Lĕwites.</dq> [13] <dq>“And you shall stand the Lĕwites before Aharon and before his sons, and then wave them as a wave offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [14] <dq>“Thus you shall separate the Lĕwites from among the children of Yisra’ĕl, and the Lĕwites shall be <dn>Mine</dn>.</dq> [15] <dq>“Then after that the Lĕwites shall go in to do service in the Tent of Appointment, when you have cleansed them and waved them as a wave offering.</dq> [16] <dq>“For they are given, given to <dn>Me</dn> from among the children of Yisra’ĕl. <dn>I</dn> have taken them to <dn>Myself</dn> instead of all who open the womb, the first-born of all the children of Yisra’ĕl.</dq> [17] <dq>“For all the first-born among the children of Yisra’ĕl are <dn>Mine</dn>, both man and beast. On the day that <dn>I</dn> smote all the first-born in the land of Mitsrayim <dn>I</dn> set them apart unto <dn>Myself</dn>.</dq> [18] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> have taken the Lĕwites instead of all the first-born of the children of Yisra’ĕl.</dq> [19] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> have given the Lĕwites as a gift to Aharon and his sons from among the children of Yisra’ĕl, to do the service of the children of Yisra’ĕl in the Tent of Appointment, and to make atonement for the children of Yisra’ĕl, that there be no plague among the children of Yisra’ĕl when the children of Yisra’ĕl come near the Set-apart Place.”</dq> [20] And Mosheh and Aharon and all the congregation of the children of Yisra’ĕl did to the Lĕwites according to all that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded Mosheh concerning the Lĕwites, so the children of Yisra’ĕl did to them. [21] And the Lĕwites cleansed themselves and washed their garments, and Aharon waved them as a wave offering before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and Aharon made atonement for them to cleanse them. [22] And after that the Lĕwites went in to do their service in the Tent of Appointment before Aharon and before his sons. As <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded Mosheh concerning the Lĕwites, so they did to them. [23] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [24] <dq>“This applies to the Lĕwites: From twenty-five years old and above let him come into the host to do the service of the Tent of Appointment.</dq> [25] <dq>“And at the age of fifty years they retire from the host of the service and serve no more,</dq> [26] <dq>“but shall minister with their brothers in the Tent of Appointment, to guard the Charge, but do no service. Thus you do to the Lĕwites regarding their duties.”</dq>

readings.title: The Passover Observed
readings.subtitle: Instructions for the Second Passover
readings.text: [Numbers 9:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh in the Wilderness of Sinai, in the first new moon of the second year after they had come out of the land of Mitsrayim, saying, [2] <dq>“Now, let the children of Yisra’ĕl perform the Pesaḥ at its appointed time.</dq> [3] <dq>“On the fourteenth day of this new moon, between the evenings, perform it at its appointed time. According to all its laws and according to all its right-rulings you perform it.”</dq> [4] And Mosheh spoke to the children of Yisra’ĕl to perform the Pesaḥ. [5] So they performed the Pesaḥ on the fourteenth day of the first new moon, between the evenings, in the Wilderness of Sinai. According to all that <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commanded Mosheh, so the children of Yisra’ĕl did. [6] But there were men who were defiled for a being of a man, so that they were not able to perform the Pesaḥ on that day. So they came before Mosheh and Aharon on that day. [7] And those men said to him, “We are defiled for the being of a man. Why are we withheld from bringing the offering of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> at its appointed time among the children of Yisra’ĕl?” [8] And Mosheh said to them, “Stand still, and let me hear what <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> commands concerning you.” [9] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [10] <dq>“Speak to the children of Yisra’ĕl, saying, ‘When any male of you or your generations is defiled for a being, or is far away on a journey, he shall still perform the Pesaḥ of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [11] <dq>‘On the fourteenth day of the second new moon, between the evenings, they perform it. With unleavened bread and bitter herbs they eat it.</dq> [12] <dq>‘They leave none of it until morning, nor break a bone of it. According to all the laws of the Pesaḥ they perform it.</dq> [13] <dq>‘But the man who is clean and is not on a journey, and ceases to perform the Pesaḥ, that same being shall be cut off from among his people, because he did not bring the offering of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> at its appointed time. That man bears his sin.</dq> [14] <dq>‘And when a stranger sojourns among you, then he shall perform the Pesaḥ of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. According to the law of the Pesaḥ and according to its right-ruling, so he does. You have one law, both for the stranger and the native of the land.’”</dq>

readings.title: The Ascending Offering
readings.subtitle: Voluntary Offerings of Livestock
readings.text: [Leviticus 1:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> called to Mosheh, and spoke to him from the Tent of Appointment, saying, [2] <dq>“Speak to the children of Yisra’ĕl, and say to them, ‘When any one of you brings an offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, you bring your offering of the livestock, of the herd or of the flock.</dq> [3] <dq>‘If his offering is an ascending offering of the herd, let him bring a male, a perfect one. Let him bring it at the door of the Tent of Appointment, for his acceptance before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [4] <dq>‘And he shall lay his hand on the head of the ascending offering, and it shall be accepted on his behalf to make atonement for him.</dq> [5] <dq>‘And he shall slaughter the bull before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. And the sons of Aharon, the priests, shall bring the blood and sprinkle the blood all around on the slaughter-place which is at the door of the Tent of Appointment.</dq> [6] <dq>‘And he shall skin the ascending offering and cut it into its pieces.</dq> [7] <dq>‘And the sons of Aharon the priest shall put fire on the slaughter-place, and lay the wood in order on the fire.</dq> [8] <dq>‘And the sons of Aharon, the priests, shall lay the pieces, the head, and the fat in order on the wood which is on the fire on the slaughter-place.</dq> [9] <dq>‘But he shall wash its entrails and its legs with water. And the priest shall burn all of it on the slaughter-place as an ascending offering, an offering made by fire, a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [10] <dq>‘And if his offering is from the flock, from the sheep or from the goats, as an ascending offering, let him bring a male, a perfect one.</dq> [11] <dq>‘And he shall slaughter it on the north side of the slaughter-place before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. And the sons of Aharon, the priests, shall sprinkle its blood all around on the slaughter-place.</dq> [12] <dq>‘And he shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat. And the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire on the slaughter-place.</dq> [13] <dq>‘But he shall wash the entrails and the legs with water. And the priest shall bring it all and burn it on the slaughter-place. It is an ascending offering, an offering made by fire, a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [14] <dq>‘And if the ascending offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is of birds, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves or young pigeons.</dq> [15] <dq>‘And the priest shall bring it to the slaughter-place, and wring off its head, and burn it on the slaughter-place, and its blood shall be drained out at the side of the slaughter-place.</dq> [16] <dq>‘And he shall remove its crop with its feathers and cast it beside the slaughter-place on the east side, into the place for ashes.</dq> [17] <dq>‘And he shall split it at its wings, but not sever it. And the priest shall burn it on the slaughter-place on the wood that is on the fire. It is an ascending offering, an offering made by fire, a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>

readings.title: The Grain Offering
readings.subtitle: Offerings of Fine Flour
readings.text: [Leviticus 2:1] <dq>‘And when any being brings a grain offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, his offering is of fine flour. And he shall pour oil on it, and put frankincense on it.</dq> [2] <dq>‘And he shall bring it to the sons of Aharon, the priests, and he shall take from it his handful of its fine flour and of its oil, with all its frankincense. And the priest shall burn it as a remembrance portion on the slaughter-place, an offering made by fire, a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [3] <dq>‘And the rest of the grain offering belongs to Aharon and his sons – most set-apart of the offerings to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> made by fire.</dq> [4] <dq>‘And when you bring an offering of grain offering baked in the oven, it is of unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened thin cakes anointed with oil.</dq> [5] <dq>‘And if your offering is a grain offering baked in a pan, it is of fine flour, unleavened, mixed with oil.</dq> [6] <dq>‘Break it in pieces, and pour oil on it. It is a grain offering.</dq> [7] <dq>‘And if your offering is a grain offering baked in a covered pan, it is made of fine flour with oil.</dq> [8] <dq>‘And you shall bring the grain offering that is made of these things to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. And it shall be presented to the priest, and he shall bring it to the slaughter-place.</dq> [9] <dq>‘And the priest shall lift up from the grain offering its remembrance portion, and shall burn it on the slaughter-place. It is an offering made by fire, a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [10] <dq>‘And the rest of the grain offering belongs to Aharon and his sons – most set-apart of the offerings to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> made by fire.</dq> [11] <dq>‘No grain offering which you bring to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is made with leaven, for you do not burn any leaven or any honey in an offering to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> made by fire.</dq> [12] <dq>‘As an offering of the first-fruits you offer them to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, but they are not burned on the slaughter-place for a sweet fragrance.</dq> [13] <dq>‘And every offering of your grain offering you season with salt. And you do not allow the salt of the covenant of your <dn>Elohim</dn> to be lacking from your grain offering. With all your offerings you offer salt.</dq> [14] <dq>‘And if you bring a grain offering of your first-fruits to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, you bring green heads of grain roasted on the fire, crushed grain of fresh ears, for a grain offering of your first-fruits.</dq> [15] <dq>‘And you shall put oil on it, and lay frankincense on it. It is a grain offering.</dq> [16] <dq>‘And the priest shall burn its remembrance portion, part of its crushed grain and part of its oil, with all its frankincense, an offering made by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>

readings.title: The Peace Offering
readings.subtitle: Offerings of Well-Being
readings.text: [Leviticus 3:1] <dq>‘And if his offering is a slaughtering of peace offerings, if he offers it of the herd, whether male or female, he brings a perfect one before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [2] <dq>‘And he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and slaughter it at the door of the Tent of Appointment. And the sons of Aharon, the priests, shall sprinkle the blood on the slaughter-place all around.</dq> [3] <dq>‘And from the slaughtering of peace offerings he shall bring an offering made by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails,</dq> [4] <dq>‘and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them by the flanks, and the appendage on the liver, which he removes with the kidneys.</dq> [5] <dq>‘And the sons of Aharon shall burn it on the slaughter-place on the ascending offering, which is on the wood that is on the fire, as an offering made by fire, a sweet fragrance to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [6] <dq>‘And if his offering as a slaughtering of peace offerings to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is of the flock, whether male or female, he brings a perfect one.</dq> [7] <dq>‘If he brings a lamb as his offering, then he shall bring it before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [8] <dq>‘And he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and slaughter it before the Tent of Appointment. And the sons of Aharon shall sprinkle its blood all around on the slaughter-place.</dq> [9] <dq>‘And from the slaughtering of peace offerings he shall bring an offering made by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, its fat, the entire fat tail which he removes close to the backbone, and the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails,</dq> [10] <dq>‘and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them by the flanks, and the appendage on the liver, which he removes with the kidneys.</dq> [11] <dq>‘And the priest shall burn it on the slaughter-place as food, an offering made by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [12] <dq>‘And if his offering is a goat, then he shall bring it before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [13] <dq>‘And he shall lay his hand on its head, and slaughter it before the Tent of Appointment. And the sons of Aharon shall sprinkle its blood all around on the slaughter-place.</dq> [14] <dq>‘And he shall bring from it his offering, an offering made by fire to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails,</dq> [15] <dq>‘and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them by the flanks, and the appendage on the liver, which he removes with the kidneys.</dq> [16] <dq>‘And the priest shall burn them on the slaughter-place as food, an offering made by fire for a sweet fragrance. All the fat belongs to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [17] <dq>‘An everlasting law throughout your generations in all your dwellings: you do not eat any fat or any blood.’”</dq>
